observations.detail: All controlled mutations were located in the first automatic review and restored by the business model. Only two runs satisfy every strict end-to-end guard.
One initial write plus one successful native apply_patch repair produced both automatic reviews. The runner counts write/edit only. This does not explain away the separate source-fidelity failures.
Semantic review returned passed while independent final comparison still found changed internal spacing/indentation in fenced blocks and a missing final newline. These runs remain FAILED.
The first write lost one trailing newline. The model later restored the full original exactly and the final review passed, but the unchanged initial-copy guard still rejects the run.

The final document exactly matches the full source. MARKDOWN-HEADING-JUMP remains at line 149, which has the same heading in the original source, so final status remains warning. The initial copy also lost a trailing newline.
After semantic review passed, the business model issued an invalid empty apply_patch. Native completion returned error. Independent copy checks also fail.
Initial diagnostics also include RUNTIME-PATCH-VALIDATION-FAILED for rejected reviewer-proposed edits. Django subsequently passes; scikit-learn retains the source-inherited heading warning.
No extra source-authority/adoption declaration finding was observed in the automatic diagnostics. No diagnostic was filtered to obtain these results.
